meta.ends_rule: each figure is the two methods' mean at specifications 16 (low) and 11 (high), the case's ends in both methods (found); the on_v6 figures are v6 at the same specifications, v6 at the personal allocation (v6's own lineage_addition.json is at 48 / 11, both allocations)
meta.parts_rule: at the case's responses: later = C(l, g) - C(0, g), G3-rate = C(l, g) - C(l, 0), each with the items' parts on those people (v6's: item 3's age mix, item 1's lineage_oasdi and lineage_part_a, item 2's scaling of their cells; v7's lineage_g3plus and lineage_whites parts: job_capital_taxes's, child_credits's G3+ term, white_end_tax_keys's and row4_frame's); user_fees is union-only; child_credits's term on them is gated
meta.union_rule: U = C(l, 0) + C(0, g) - C(l, g), the cost with nobody added (the cost is affine in the counts at fixed responses, gated); at the case's responses the union there, at the union's own the union-only case; the union's response is the first less the second
meta.addition_rule: the lineage's addition = v6 less the union-only case = the added people + the union's response
meta.route: v6's caseOf at lineage options built by lineage_count.cjs additionsAt (its lineageBase() and caseOf() repeated here for options it does not name), then v7's layer (package.cjs caseOn)

union_only.rule: v7 without the lineage: the September 29 union with the union's items (pension_tr2026's union parts, retiree_health, user_fees, child_credits's, job_capital_taxes's and row4_frame's union parts) at the union's own responses
